excluded: A reviewer whose initial ratings were produced jointly with the other reviewer
declarations: No participation in designing the rated artifact
Independent initial ratings submitted before discussion; actual response evidence retained

response_requirements: Group identifier and exact artifact/source SHA-256
Reviewer identity/role/eligibility declaration and attributable actual response reference
Separate rating and rationale for every declared aspect
Supporting primary-source locators and counterexamples, or explicit missing evidence
Response timestamp; initial ratings append-only; corrections create linked later records
process: Freeze protocol/cohort/source packets before any response; obtain actual reviewer eligibility declarations.
Give exact model/source/counterexample packets to each reviewer; keep initial ratings separate. Author dispositions are contextual material to inspect after independent initial judgments.
Preserve raw responses and aspect ratings; unknown/abstain/missing never become acceptance.
Record disagreements; a third independent adjudicator resolves them with cited reasons, preserving initial ratings.
Report completed paired groups, accepted/revised/rejected/unresolved groups, and reviewed/full-inventory counts separately. All aspects and both roles are needed for completion.
Report categorical agreement only on genuinely paired comparable initial ratings; no overall truth percentage or unjustified confidence interval.
Update affected claims/scope/artifact versions only from actual dispositions. Unresolved critical findings in retained claims require correction or explicit withdrawal.
